result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there is one clear visual defect: overlapping metadata text under the Tokumaru Ramen Bar listing where the delivery time and delivery fee render on top of each other, producing garbled text.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the metadata line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows overlapping text ('25–35 min' and '€0 delivery' are rendered on top of each other, reading roughly '25–3€0dmiliivery'), making the information unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Lay out the metadata items (time, delivery fee, cuisine) in a horizontal flex/stack container with proper spacing and separators instead of absolutely positioning them, so they cannot overlap.
